Height = forecast transactions. Green = offers eligible.

Busy = the larger of forecast demand / branch busy threshold and forecast demand / network busy threshold reaches 1. Thresholds use the recent observed 75th percentile. This is a pilot rule, not a measure of spare capacity.

02 · BUILD A REASON TO STOP BY

Candidates pair a popular drink with below-median-volume food that has positive margin. Co-purchase support is shown as evidence, not proof of demand. Bundle size, offer count and limits are policy choices; they are not learned optimal decisions. Confirm inventory, ingredients and current prices before a real offer.

Baseline revenue is a tested forecast. Baseline gross profit is revenue × the branch’s Jan–May recorded gross-margin ratio. Offer changes are accounting scenarios with no causal estimate. New baskets, add-ons and would-buy-anyway baskets are mutually exclusive assumptions. No traffic shift from another hour, substitution, stockouts, labor or extra waste is modeled unless included in additional cost.

04 · EVIDENCE YOU CAN INSPECT

The model has to
earn its place.

Models train on Jan–Apr, May chooses model/baseline by MAE, and June tests rolling one-day predictions with fixed parameters. June outcomes were already inspected in earlier project work, so this new task needs prospective validation. The displayed July 1 demo is refit on all available data through June 30; it is not a current-day forecast.

Policy and experiment design

At or above either busy threshold: zero offers. Otherwise redemption cap = min(floor(0.30 × forecast transactions), ceil(0.30 × forecast transactions × (1 − pressure))). Up to two distinct bundles if pressure <0.55, otherwise one, never more than the cap. No capacity or stock data exists, so these are conservative pilot rules.

Discounts are capped at 12% and at 1 − cost / (list price × (1 − required gross margin)). Checkout prices round up to the next cent to preserve the margin. Positive gross margin is not net profitability.

Before launch, reconcile branch costs, verify stock and train staff. Randomize eligible slots within branch/day/hour strata to current practice versus offers, using sufficiently large blocks and accounting for carryover and substitute products. Pre-register total gross profit net of discount, waste and extra labor per assigned slot as the primary endpoint. Log exposure, redemption, sell-outs and displaced full-price purchases. Use a cluster-aware analysis and power the trial from pilot variance; do not claim extra profit from this simulation.
